decision:
ACTION: NUCLEI
TARGET: http://192.168.56.10
PARAMETERS: -u http://192.168.56.10 -as -severity low,medium,high,critical
REASON: As this is the initial reconnaissance phase with no previous observations, Nuclei is the best first choice because it performs automated vulnerability scanning with a comprehensive template library. It will quickly identify potential attack vectors including exposed services, misconfigurations, CVEs, and common vulnerabilities across the target web application. The `-as` flag enables automatic web technology detection, and scanning all severity levels ensures we don't miss any potential entry points for further exploitation.

ACTION: CURL
TARGET: http://192.168.56.10
PARAMETERS: -v -X GET http://192.168.56.10 -L
REASON: Since Nuclei didn't detect any vulnerabilities, I need to manually explore the target to understand its structure. Using CURL with verbose mode (-v) and following redirects (-L) will help me identify the web server type, response headers, potential entry points, forms, and application structure. This reconnaissance will reveal what technologies are in use and identify potential parameters or endpoints that could be tested for SQL injection or command injection vulnerabilities in subsequent steps.
